public_rationale: Under the practical-capability reading, the claim is contradicted. Before the post, [customer-support research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.11771v1) documented operational benefits, and a [writing experiment](https://economics.mit.edu/news/study-finds-chatgpt-boosts-worker-productivity-some-writing-tasks) found faster work with better evaluated output. Those demonstrations go beyond fundraising and publicity. They do not prove historically unprecedented tasks, economy-wide transformation, or universal usefulness; a stricter novelty reading would remain unresolved.
limitations: The result depends on reading 'substantially different' as materially useful practical capability.
The customer-support evidence was a preprint at the post date.
The writing experiment simplified factual-accuracy and workplace-context requirements.
The studies establish bounded benefits, not the viability of every generative-AI investment.

statement.excerpt: Artificial intelligence isn't new, these models aren't new, and after just over a year of hype, generative AI is yet to prove it can do anything substantially different other than helping tech company CEOs raise money and create headlines.

our_interpretation: The ordinary practical reading is that generative AI had demonstrated no materially useful capability beyond fundraising and publicity.
I treat independently measured improvements in producing useful work as materially different practical capabilities; I do not require invention of an activity humans had never performed.
This is a cumulative claim about what had been demonstrated by publication. The target period therefore has an open beginning and ends on 2024-04-04.
The historical statements that AI and these model families were not new are background, not claims that the cited studies could refute.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence available by the post establishes that purported practical capabilities had not produced material, demonstrated benefits beyond promotion and fundraising.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one credible demonstration public by 2024-04-04 establishes a materially useful generative-AI capability beyond promotion or fundraising.
